Coalesce Two Values

Source: R/zzz.R
dot-coalesce.Rd

Returns the first non-NULL value from the given inputs.

Usage

.coalesce(x, y)

Arguments

x

First value to check.

y

Fallback value if `x` is NULL.

Value

The first non-NULL value. If `x` is NULL, returns `y`.
